expectations.text: Identifies punctuation scarcity / long unpunctuated sentences / 'and' as joint, names UNDER-PUNCT as stable ID
Rewritten text has >=6 sentence-ending periods (source has 3)
Adds internal punctuation, replacing >=3 propositional 'and' joints with period/semicolon/comma+relationship-word/subordination
Does not treat 'and' as a watch-list word or count UNDER-PUNCT toward density/spread score
Every source figure survives unchanged (2017, two boroughs, seven boroughs, 2020, four to nineteen staff, etc.)
Same-kind 'and'-joined series in the source left as a series, not split
No new AI tell introduced (inflation, -ing analysis, negative parallelism, generic closer, failing rule-of-three)
